text: The lab receives an NIH NIGMS Maximizing Investigators' Research Award (R35 MIRA, 1R35GM162519), Next-generation single-cell multiomic methods for quantifying cellular identity, funding the research program through 2031.

Avi presents Isoform-Resolved Single-Cell Transcriptomics of Immunological Dysregulation at the Wistar Institute Faculty Seminar. Talk slides cover BenchDrop-seq, Bagpiper, and the RRAS isoform switching story in melanoma.

BenchDrop-seq posted on bioRxiv. A microfluidics-free benchtop platform for single-cell long-read RNA sequencing — PIP-seq capture combined with Oxford Nanopore sequencing and the Bagpiper analysis pipeline.
New preprint: EBV infection outcomes determined by monocyte and Treg-driven immune dynamics in an ex vivo PBMC model. A collaboration with the Lieberman lab at Wistar.
New preprint: Targetable treatment resistance in thyroid cancer with clonal hematopoiesis.
Seurat v5 published in Nature Biotechnology. Dictionary learning for integrative, multimodal and scalable single-cell analysis.
Best practices for single-cell analysis across modalities published in Nature Reviews Genetics.
Alevin-fry published in Nature Methods. Rapid, accurate and memory-frugal quantification of single-cell RNA-seq data.
scCUT&Tag-pro published in Nature Biotechnology. Characterizing cellular heterogeneity in chromatin state with a new multimodal single-cell assay.
Signac published in Nature Methods. A comprehensive toolkit for the analysis of single-cell chromatin data.
